# MUS-W-0011

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**A write path into the store**

work-unit · 2026-08-20

Discharges: [MUS-M-0004](../milestones.md#mus-m-0004)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0037](../decisions.md#mus-d-0037)

Closes: [MUS-F-0007](../findings.md#mus-f-0007)

## Context

mustur add and mustur amend, so a record can be written without editing the bootstrap and re-seeding.

## Depends on

MUS-M-0002's store.

## Discharges

MUS-F-0007, and the precondition for MUS-M-0004: intake needs somewhere to put a jot.

## Done means

A record can be written without touching internal/seed/data.
An identifier is allocated from the log rather than from a count, so a serial is never reused; asserted by a test that amends a record and checks the next serial did not move.
Serials are scoped to a project and a role, so a decision does not push a finding's number along.
An amendment states the record afresh rather than merging over the old one, and the earlier version stays in the log.
A flag written after a positional argument is read, in every command that takes one.

## Risks

The export stopped being reproducible from git alone the moment this existed, which is the trade MUS-D-0037 records. Nothing in an unattended run can now check records/ against the store.
mustur seed still refuses a non-empty store, which is what stops the bootstrap and the database becoming two sources. Nothing enforces that the bootstrap is not edited afterwards; it is simply no longer read.
